'''Squarg''' was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] until [[3641 BBY]] when the crime lord [[Ivory]] arranged an escape of himself and his associates, including Squarg. Along with [[Buzz (Geonosian)|Buzz]], Squarg was attempting to free [[Agrular]] from [[Cell block 2018]] when both were interrupted by the [[Voidhound]] and subsequently killed.
